description: This file defines the class 'fogbugzdbInterface', which extends 'issueTrackerInterface' and provides methods for integrating with FogBugz bug tracking system, including constructing URLs, retrieving issue details, checking bug existence, and generating HTML links.

classes.name: fogbugzdbInterface
classes.description: Class for integrating TestLink with FogBugz bug tracking system, providing URL construction, issue retrieval, status checking, and HTML link generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets connection via database, and configures options.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs URL to view a specific bug by ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a bug from the database.

methods.name: getBugStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a bug by ID.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug with the given ID exists.

methods.name: buildViewBugLink
methods.description: Generates an HTML link to view the bug with styling based on status.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the format of a bug ID.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Creates an HTML string representing the bug's status with styling.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface type used in configuration.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for configuration settings for FogBugz integration.
